submittedPrompt: 绘制清晰中文局部组件，白底/浅灰面、蓝色主动作、细边框小圆角、紧凑易读。只画组件和留白，不画外部导航或品牌页头。绘制一个宽的主页实时预览组件。顶部左“访客视角”，小字“未保存的修改也能预览”，右侧两个按钮“桌面”“手机”，桌面选中；下一行勾选“实时预览”，文字按钮“刷新预览”。下方嵌入桌面博客预览区，内容严格依博客参考：绿色强调色#44684f，顶部横条“装修草稿预览 · 仅你可见”，站名“隔离示例手记”，副标题“真实接口驱动的界面盘点样例。”；导航“首页”“文章”“专题”“归档”“关于”“RSS”，首页选中；左栏“关于我”“记录、连接与行动”“示例作者”“浏览文章 →”；右侧“精选文章”下面两条同样的文章“让知识保持可用”，日期2026-11-04、分类方法、置顶，摘要“用于页面盘点的隔离发布快照。”；下方“最近更新”同类列表在预览窗口内部可滚动。预览区域外底部提示“预览仅自己可见。发布主页后访客才能看到更改。”。不加工作室表单、发布/保存按钮、外部主人导航或浏览器边框。

sourceContracts.title: 博客装修：实时私有预览

entry.trigger: Design mounted; editor changes or manual refresh; direct authenticated GET /api/blog/design/preview

permissionRules: Owner session required for design/media APIs. Saving a draft, private preview or restoring history does not publish; version-checked explicit publish changes guest homepage.

GET /api/blog/design/preview is an owner-authenticated API route under the same /api/ session hook; it is not an anonymous /blog preview link. The preview service authorizes the owner principal and may preview a disabled public site.

actions.label: 刷新预览 / 重试预览 / 生成预览

importantStates: preview busy; latest-request wins; failure retains last successful HTML and retry

Direct authenticated GET /api/blog/design/preview returns the same private homepage template as standalone text/html with the private-preview banner, using the stored design draft; no studio form or embedded device controls wrap this response.
POST /api/blog/design/preview accepts current unsaved design and returns JSON {html}; this differs from the direct GET HTML route.

responsive.supported: Source-defined responsive layout; not runtime-verified in this read-only inventory
responsive.behavior: <=1250px editor/preview stack; <=760px forms/cards/dialog compress. Preview internally keeps 1100px desktop or 375px mobile viewport and scales to host (BlogPreviewViewport.vue:34). Runtime unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: A concrete state with its own content, action hierarchy and business state; include in the GPT Image 2 review queue before implementation.
notes: Sandbox allow-same-origin only; no allow-scripts. Owner-only media endpoints; preview does not publish.

The direct GET is an alias/entry for this same owner homepage-preview surface, not another public route or invented UI button. Its HTML body uses homeHtml and previewSource; the studio POST is the live unsaved-design flow.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.

concerns: Static raster is not proof of executed actions, owner/recipient permissions, focus/keyboard, guard enforcement, canvas topology or responsive fit.
